subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw support non-USD currency semantics for configured local model-cost estimates, and if yes should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a new config surface and affects schema, docs, status output, Control UI aggregation, persisted `estimatedCostUsd`, telemetry naming, and provider-billing boundaries; code cannot safely infer that product contract.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose the supported scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so every cost surface stays consistent.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD per million tokens and keep non-USD billing visible only through provider-reported usage snapshots.

options.title: Add display-only symbols
options.body: Allow a narrow formatter preference while explicitly keeping stored values and aggregate telemetry as USD-like local estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the supported scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so every cost surface stays consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the most recent merged provider billing and cost-history work and is the best available routing candidate for the product/config decision.
